reason: A browser-side DeepSeek Harness theme that presents workspaces and sessions in a Windows XP-style desktop with floating windows, taskbar navigation, workspace selection, session search, and native directory picking.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面改造成 Windows XP 风格桌面，并提供浮动会话窗口、任务栏、工作区浏览、会话搜索和原生目录选择。
summaries.en: Transforms the DeepSeek Harness web interface into a Windows XP-style desktop with floating session windows, taskbar navigation, workspace browsing, session search, and native directory selection.

capabilities: Replaces the web GUI with a Windows XP-inspired desktop layout
Provides draggable, resizable, minimizable, maximizable, and closable session windows
Persists window scene state across page refreshes
Uses the host native directory picker to add workspaces
Searches session content through the host sessions.search capability
